verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Termius bundles Mosh, which is specifically designed to keep terminal sessions alive across network changes and device sleep/roaming, and a user reports successfully using it for exactly this scenario (debugging via iPhone while away from a stable network). However, no first-party Termius documentation in the evidence pack explicitly describes this persistence capability, so the claim rests solely on a single hands-on anecdote. Missing for 10: official docs describing Mosh/session persistence behavior, explicit device-sleep handling details, and broader independent corroboration beyond one HN comment.
